rav-yehuda-bar-ami.name: Rav Yehuda bar Ami
rav-yehuda-bar-ami.bio: Amora who transmits, in the name of Rav Yehuda, that a trodden beit haperas is pure.
rav-yehuda-bar-ami.prompt: A scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and attentive eyes, one hand gesturing down toward a well-trodden dirt path; background of a Babylonian field track between low mud-brick walls.
